annotations.title: Renew an LEI without signing in

description: Orders the renewal of one LEI that Global FinReg manages, for a user who isn't signed in. Only call it after showing the user the price from get_lei_renewal_offer and getting their explicit agreement. paymentMethod 'card' returns paymentUrl, the payment provider's own page: give it to the user, who pays there without signing in (never ask for card details); the renewal is processed once paid. paymentMethod 'invoice' needs renewalLink: it commits the user to paying, confirms the renewal straight away and returns the invoice PDF to pay by bank transfer.

expectedTotal.description: The total from get_lei_renewal_offer that the user agreed to. The order is refused if the price has changed.

lei.description: The 20-character LEI to renew, e.g. 894500AAX24OVFGAR954. Leave it out when you pass renewalLink.

paymentMethod.description: 'card' (pay online by card) or 'invoice' (pay by bank transfer; only with renewalLink).

renewalLink.description: Optional: the renewal link from Global FinReg's renewal reminder email, exactly as the user gives it (https://.../lei/renewal-link?lei=...&t=...). With it the renewal can also be paid by invoice.

years.description: Renewal period in years: 1, 3 or 5, as offered.

name: order_lei_renewal
title: Renew an LEI without signing in
